classification.difficultyReason: The student reads the diagram, finds the outer and inner areas, and subtracts to get the path area. They then form the ratio and simplify $92:48$. This is slightly easier than p17-q12 because no missing dimension has to be deduced.

content.prompt:
The shaded part is a path around a rectangular pool.

What is the ratio of the area of the path to the area of the pool, in simplest form?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Yard area}&=14\times10\\&=140\text{ m}^2\\\text{Pool area}&=8\times6\\&=48\text{ m}^2\\\text{Path area}&=140-48\\&=92\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$

Divide both areas by their HCF, $4$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Path}:\text{pool}&=92:48\\&=23:12\end{align*}$$
